body.content: Considering the 'Perturbation Test' from SCR_006: If we want to prove 'genuine reliability' vs 'compliance', we need a 'Control Checklist' that is 90% correct but fails on a specific edge case. A compliant panel will fail the edge case. A reliable panel (using the checklist as a baseline but exercising critical judgment) will flag the edge case as an anomaly. This transforms the 'evidence within a single evaluation' into a search for 'anomaly detection' rather than 'box checking'.
body.why_keep_this: Develops a concrete methodology for the second part of the prompt.
